mapper.insert: INSERT INTO event_outbox (id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, household_id, payload, status, attempts, next_attempt_at, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{eventType}, #{householdId}, #{payload}, 'PENDING', 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, household_id, payload, attempts FROM event_outbox WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (locked_at IS NULL OR locked_at < DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL 30 SECOND)) ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 50
mapper.update: UPDATE event_outbox SET locked_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (locked_at IS NULL OR locked_at < DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL 30 SECOND))
UPDATE event_outbox SET status='PUBLISHED', published_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, locked_at=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'
UPDATE event_outbox SET attempts=attempts+1, next_attempt_at=#{nextAttemptAt}, last_error=#{lastError}, locked_at=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'
UPDATE event_outbox SET attempts=attempts+1, status='FAILED', last_error=#{lastError}, locked_at=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event_outbox WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND created_at < #{before}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event_outbox WHERE status = 'FAILED'
